title: Retry-After interoperability policy for Northstar staging
body: Wes Contract decides Retry-After interoperability for Northstar staging. Revised decision: accept unsigned finite decimal seconds such as 0.5, but reject every leading plus sign including +3 and +0.5 with InvalidHeader. A compatibility review found plus signs must stay invalid. Keep ordinary integer return types, HTTP dates, retry_after_max clamping, backoff and retry methods unchanged. Reject negatives, exponents, NaN and infinity. Add regression tests only. This source is evidence and the rollout requires fresh owner signoff.
author: Wes Contract
